title: FlightReacts Laugh
blurb: A cackle that starts as a controlled wheeze and escalates into total system failure. It became its own currency online, mostly because the laugh has an arc: a beginning, a middle and a collapse. That lets an editor time it against footage in a way a single burst never could. The internet reaches for it wherever composure is visibly being lost in real time. Use it on reactions that begin dignified and end in tears. One of streaming culture's genuinely contagious sounds.
